message.content:
Below is a concise snapshot of key Texas traffic‑law provisions (as of 2025). For detailed statutes, consult the Texas Transportation Code or official state resources such as TxDOT’s “Texas Driver Handbook” or the Texas Department of Public Safety website. | Topic | Key Points | |-------|------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits vary from 35–75 mph depending on road type.
• Rural interstate highways typically have a default limit of 70 mph unless posted otherwise.
• Speed enforcement uses radar/laser; exceeding limits may trigger points & fines. | | **Seat Belt Law** | • All occupants must wear seat belts at all times when vehicle is moving.
• Failure results in a $50 fine plus one point on driver’s record. | | **DUI / Alcohol Limit** | • Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) ≥0.08% constitutes DUI.
• Lower BAC thresholds apply to commercial drivers (≥0.04%) and under‑age drivers (≤0%).
• Penalties include license suspension, mandatory education programs, and possible jail time. | | **Texting While Driving** | • Handheld device usage prohibited for both drivers and passengers.
• Violation carries a $200 fine + two points. | | **Child Restraint Requirements** | • Children <8 years old must ride rear‑facing until age 2, then forward‑-facing until 4, then booster seats until 8 or 57 lbs.
• Violations result in a $100 fine + points. | | **Helmet Use for Motorcycles** | • Helmets required for riders <16 yrs and for those who do not hold a motorcycle endorsement.
• Fines up to $150 per violation. | | **Right‑of‑Way Rules** | • Vehicles turning left must yield to pedestrians crossing their lane.
• At uncontrolled intersections, vehicles proceeding straight have priority over turns. | | **School Bus Stop Sign** | • Drivers must stop within 20 ft of school bus stopping sign when it displays red lights.
• Failure leads to a $250 fine + points. | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking within 15 ft of fire hydrants, crosswalks, or driveways without signage permitting it.
• Parking violations often lead to towing fees ($300+). | | **Points System** | • Accumulating 12 points triggers automatic license revocation after 90 days.
• Points remain on record for 36 months. | ### How to Get More Detailed Information 1. **TxDOT – Texas Driver Handbook** *PDF download includes full text of most relevant sections.* 2. **Texas Department of Public Safety – Traffic Laws Page** *Interactive guide covering penalties, citations, and legal definitions.* 3. **Legal Research Sites** - FindLaw.com/Texas/Law/Traffic-Laws - Nolo.com/Texas-Traffic-Code Feel free to let me know if you’d like deeper dives into any specific area—e.g., how to contest a ticket, details on toll roads, or recent legislative changes!
